abstract: A case of bilateral gonadoblastoma in 46,XY gonadal dysgenesis is presented and discussed by both clinician and pathologist, in this traditional clinico-pathologic conference. The discussion includes the differential diagnoses of primary amenorrhoea.
abstract_ja: 46,XY性腺異形成に伴う両側性性腺芽腫の症例を提示し、臨床医と病理医がこの伝統的な臨床病理カンファレンスで検討する。原発性無月経の鑑別診断も議論する。
